mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Duskbringer: Hasted</titleLeft><mainText>Nocturne has increased Move Speed and Bonus Attack Damage, and can move through units while on the Dusk Trail.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Nocturne throws a shadow blade, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and leaving a dusk trail for @TrailDuration@ seconds. Enemy champions hit also leave a trail.

While on the trail, Nocturne is Ghosted and gains @MoveSpeed@% Move Speed and @BonusTrailAD@ Attack Damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple:
Throws a shadow blade, damaging enemeis struck and leaving a Dusk Trail.

Nocturne gains @MoveSpeed@% Move Speed and @BonusTrailAD@ Attack Damage on the trail.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Duskbringer: Dusk Trail</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is leaving behind a Dusk Trail, empowering Nocturne while he is on it.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
Nocturne's next attack will cleave through all nearby enemies and heal him for each one hit.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nocturne's next attack will cleave through all nearby enemies and heal him for each one hit.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself.

Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Every @Cooldown@ seconds, Nocturne's next Attack strikes all nearby enemies for @TotalDamageNoCrit@ physical damage and restores @TotalHealing@ Health per target hit.

Nocturne's Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @AACDR@ second, increased to @AAChampMonsterCDR@ against champions and jungle monsters.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Every @Cooldown@ seconds, Nocturne's next Attack strikes all nearby enemies for @TotalDamageNoCrit@ physical damage and restores @TotalHealing@ Health per target hit.

Nocturne's Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @AACDR@ second, increased to @AAChampMonsterCDR@ against champions and jungle monsters.

Umbra Blades deals @DamageMinionMod*100@% less damage to minions and heals @HealMinionMod*100@% less from lane minions.

mBuff.mDescription: Nocturne's next attack will cleave through all nearby enemies and heal him for each one hit.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Paranoia</titleLeft><mainText>Nocturne may activate Paranoia to charge at a nearby enemy.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nocturne darkens the map, reducing the sight radius of all enemy champions and removing their vision of allies for @ParanoiaDuration@ seconds. Nocturne can <recast>Recast</recast> this Ability during the duration to launch himself at an enemy champion dealing <physicalDamage>@Damage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple:
Enemies cannot see what other enemies see for @ParanoiaDuration@ second(s).

Re-activate during this to dash to and damage an enemy champion.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Paranoia</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has reduced sight radius and cannot see their allies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Shroud of Darkness: Boost</titleLeft><mainText>Nocturne has increased Attack Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Nocturne gains @ActiveAS@% Attack Speed.

Active: Nocturne creates a shadow barrier for 1.5 seconds that blocks the next enemy Ability. If an Ability is blocked, this Ability's passive effect is increased to @ActiveAS*2@% Attack Speed for @DoubleASDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>This Ability will remain active during <spellName>Paranoia's</spellName> flight.</rules>
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple:
Passive: Nocturne gains @ActiveAS@% Attack Speed.

Active: Block the next enemy ability that hits him within 1.5 second(s).

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Shroud of Darkness: Shield</titleLeft><mainText>Nocturne will block the next incoming enemy ability.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
Nocturne's next attack will cleave through all nearby enemies and heal him for each one hit.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Unspeakable Horror</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is taking damage and will be terrified soon.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Nocturne gains @TooltipFearMS*100@% Move Speed toward Feared enemies.

Active: Nocturne plants a nightmare tether into his target, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage over @LeashDuration@ seconds. If the tether remains unbroken, the target is Feared for @CCDuration@ second(s).
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple:
Passive: Gain massively increased Move Speed toward feared enemies.

Active: Damages an enemy over @LeashDuration@ second(s). If this completes, the target is feared for @CCDuration@ second(s).
